method: Independent recursive schema projection to TS readonly types; token comparison preserves quoted strings and ignores formatting. Every schema declaration compared, including property optionality, arrays, records, references, enums, nullable unions and unconstrained unknown. This is structural assessment, not full manual read, TypeScript compiler validation, runtime JSON validation or server execution. Exact generated /** @deprecated */ annotations excluded from type token comparison.
declaration_parser: Anchored exports through semicolon followed by blank line or EOF; complete object declarations retained, separate deprecation comments excluded.
